objectClass.notes: Three admitted orthographic crops define the visible model. Hidden systems are resolved as explicit assumptions rather than claimed reference geometry.

reasoning: Transparent layered enclosure plus a rotating mechanism, repeated popcorn pieces, outlet architecture and rear service details require a complex hierarchy.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Identity depends on transparent structure, repeated food forms and purpose-specific powered motion.

details.description: low pink dome with broad rounded eave
lacquer highlight on pink cap and buttons
clear four-sided chamber with edge reflections
four cream corner posts joining chamber frames

definitionOfDone: Three orthographic views preserve the illustrated proportions and identity systems.
All primary assemblies are named and separable.
Powered behavior visibly produces and dispenses popcorn and restores exact idle state at 5.2 seconds.

featureGroups.name: Tall rounded cabinet and low dome
qualityCriteria: Front height-width ratio and side depth match the turn sheet.
Dome, chamber and cabinet retain distinct vertical masses.

featureGroups.name: Transparent four-sided chamber
qualityCriteria: Four glass panels, posts and upper/lower frames remain separate and legible.

featureGroups.name: Popper and popcorn system
qualityCriteria: Roof mechanism remains centered and popcorn has a dense irregular lobed pile.

featureGroups.name: Front arch and projecting tray
qualityCriteria: Arch cavity and tray create correct negative space and depth.

featureGroups.name: Controls vents and feet
qualityCriteria: Round button, side release, ten vents and four feet are visible in corresponding views.

featureGroups.name: SAKURA toon materials and powered light
qualityCriteria: Cream, lacquer pink, clear chamber, warm food, dark cavity and warm emission remain distinct.

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not merge glass into cabinet.
Do not model popcorn as one blob.
Do not accept powered state without food transformation.
mustNotDo: No popcorn may cross the inner glass boundary.
No powered transform or emission may remain after stop.
Do not claim hidden heater or underside as reference-accurate.

stopCriteria: all critical features pass and interaction resets exactly

screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: one admitted reference and one render per named view

proceduralStrategy: Build transparent panels and structural posts as separate parts.
Use deterministic multi-lobe popcorn groups inside fixed chamber bounds.
Expose control and popper pivots plus dispense and cable sockets.
Review five named stages in browser before final interaction evidence.
assumptions: Hidden heater motor gearbox and internal gate are omitted as unverified internals.
The underside and cable shape are not visible; only a rear power-cable socket is provided.
The side triangular projection is treated as a release lever with lower confidence.
Food trajectories are authored for purpose clarity while remaining within observed chamber bounds.

actionReadiness.contract: named hierarchical pivots sockets colliders and deterministic reset
actionReadiness.defaultRigType: hierarchical rigid prop plus bounded particles
authoringRules: popper and controls remain independent pivots
dispensed food follows a bounded path

featureReviews.notes: Tall cabinet, transparent chamber and low rounded dome match the reference silhouette.
Front and side panels, four posts and upper/lower frames remain independent.
Roof popper and dense lobed popcorn pile read clearly from front and side.
Arched chute, front tray and animated handful form a coherent delivery path.
Controls, rear vent pattern and feet are present in orbit views.
Cream shell, Sakura pink dome, clear chamber and warm food materials remain distinct.

reviewHistory.summary: Front, side, back and three-quarter browser views preserve the tall cabinet, framed chamber, popper, food pile and delivery path; the powered popping cycle is purpose-readable.
mismatches: translucent panels and animated food particles change binary silhouette masks

visualEvidence.notes: 四个浏览器视图均已检查；确定性二值轮廓仅作为受构图和透明材质限制的辅助证据。
